_comment: SKILL-ONLY DISCLOSURE (vibe-ic#693). A checker whose only non-TEST runner is a skill/agent/command document runs if and only if an agent reads that document and chooses to run it. `checker_execution_wiring_audit` counts SKILL as a runner deliberately, and says so; what nothing recorded was HOW MANY there are (51 of 560 on origin/main 1f3d8d067) or WHY any particular one is parked there. This file is the register for the ones that have been investigated. It is a DISCLOSURE, not permission: an entry states what the checker asserts, what it was measured to do, why wiring it automatically today would be wrong, and the CONDITION that would make it wireable. Being listed is not a licence to leave it. Reported by the audit, never blocking. It is NOT `_UNROUTED_INVENTORY` (an exact-equality ratchet over unrouted SKIP PATHS: 98 in 53 gates) and it is NOT `checker_execution_wiring_baseline.json` (which FAILS on any entry that has a runner: `paid = [c for c in baseline if c not in test_only_now]`).

reasons.benchmark_triage_absorption_audit.py: ASSERTS: open-benchmark-methodology 4.2 — every AI-solvable triage verdict (or any record with independent_blind_passes==true) carries an absorption_ref; TRUE_FLOOR/DATASET_DEFECT are exempt only with floor_evidence, and TRUE_FLOOR additionally requires independent_blind_passes==false. WORKS, and has already run on real data: 6 of 6 negative controls fire on the one published input (drop absorption_ref -> 1; relabel TRUE_FLOOR while the blind solve passed -> 1; TRUE_FLOOR with no floor_evidence -> 1; exempt + unparseable blind flag -> 1; unknown verdict -> 1; unmodified -> 0). NOT WIRED because NOTHING IN THE REPO PRODUCES ITS INPUT: `grep -rn triage_records` across programs/, tools/, skills/ and flow/ finds no producer, `find benchmark-data -name 'triage_records*.json'` returns exactly ONE file, and that one is hand-authored. A per-run gate keyed on a glob is actively dangerous here: pointed at the 46 pass_at_1.json files that DO exist at scale it reports 156 of 156 records as unknown_verdict, all spurious. OPEN DEFECT, disclosed rather than hidden by this entry: five published RESULT.md cite this audit as machine evidence and only one of them published the input, so four of those PASS claims cannot be re-verified. WIREABLE WHEN: the benchmark harness emits triage_records.json beside every RESULT.md that cites the audit; it then belongs in the RESULT.md sign-off path, keyed on that exact filename, returning rc=2/NOT CHECKED when the file is absent rather than red.
